newsitem.title: USA: AMEX October short interest down 3.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: AMEX October short interest down 3.1 mln shares.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said short interest totaled 120,019,860 shares as of the October 15 settlement date, a decrease of 3,136,405 shares from the adjusted mid-September total of 123,156,265 shares.

The October figure represents trades through October 9, the exchange said. It noted the short interest position reflects short interest reported by all broker-dealers in Amex listed stocks. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
